title: Robert Hastings' interviews on UFOs at nuclear bases
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Robert Hastings' interviews on UFOs at nuclear bases, about 1940s-present at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: comes from a very creatively named book called UFOs and Nukes by Robert Hastings.

began a lifelong journey for Hastings
interviewing 100 167 US military sources
former or retired ICBM launch officers
missile maintenance security and radar
operators
tellings.difference: This telling gives a count of 167 US military sources, names their roles (ICBM launch officers, missile maintenance, security and radar operators), calls the interviews a lifelong journey and dates them from the 1960s onward rather than the 1940s.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about Robert Hastings' body of interviews about UFOs at US nuclear sites, the research collected in his book UFOs and Nukes. The telling covers the whole research effort, not one incident inside it.

as_told.title: Hastings interviews 167 military sources on UFOs at nuclear sites

tellings.quote: He he he emailed me. He said, Jesse, it was only like 12 to 15, I don't remember the exact number, but but radar operators. the rest were ICBM security uh personnel,
tellings.difference: Hastings tells Michels by email that only about 12 to 15 were radar operators and the rest were ICBM security personnel.
tellings.link_reason: Same body of interviews behind Hastings' UFOs and Nukes and its witness count.

tellings.difference: Brings in US and UK nuclear bases, while the story's tellings speak only of US sites.
tellings.link_reason: The same account of Robert Hastings' book UFOs and Nukes and his 167 interviewed ICBM security, radar and base personnel.

as_told.title: UFOs and Nukes: ICBM personnel witnesses

tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Robert Hastings' book UFOs and Nukes and his roughly 170 nuclear-site whistleblowers.

tellings.link_reason: Both are about Robert Hastings' book UFOs and Nukes and his 167 military witnesses to UFOs at US nuclear bases.
